title: Wolf and Hollow
author: Cyrus Sterling
blurb: Edmund Ishikawa, a debt-bound temple scribe, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
